m.t: Claiming pure essence from Wizard Cromperty
m.pg: Money making guide/Claiming pure essence from Wizard Cromperty
m.h:
After completing the hard Hard Ardougne achievements, Wizard Cromperty will give you 1050 pure essence once a week. To get to Cromperty, take the Ardougne lodestone and walk south and east. He is located in the building east of the Servants' Guild. Right-click him to claim the essence. You don't need to be wearing your ardougne cloak to claim the essence.

If you've only completed the Medium Ardougne achievements you can still claim 700 essence per week; valued at 13,300 gp.

rq.h: 48 Herblore (99 Herblore (recommended))
1,000,000 gp+ recommended

m.h:
Avantoe are in high demand to create Super energy and Extreme attacks. It is often profitable to clean the grimy herbs and sell them on the Grand Exchange. Like all methods involving large amounts of buying and selling, it is recommended to test the market first to make sure cleaning avantoe is profitable.

28 herbs can be cleaned per inventory, and each inventory takes 16.8s (28 ticks), so a maximum of around 5,000 herbs can be cleaned per hour. Due to the risk of repetitive strain, it is advised to use make-x to speed up the cleaning process.

Utilising a Herblore cape, presets, and the action bar, it is possible to clean an inventory approximitely every two seconds resulting in up to 50,000 herbs cleaned per hour.

Please note that grimy avantoes have a buying limit of 10,000 every four hours, so you may clean them faster than you can buy them.

p.pre:
The methods described in this guide may involve considerable risks, including (but not limited to): loss of money and goods, price volatility, and low GE sales volume.
Reason: Grand Exchange Prices can fluctuate. Profit may be less than anticipated. Price-testing on the Grand Exchange before investing is advised. Also be aware of G E taxes.
You can discuss this issue on the [ talk page] or [ edit] this page to improve it.

m.pg: Money making guide/Cleansing the Gate of Elidinis

rq.h: Tier 80+ pickaxe (Augmentable pickaxe highly recommended)
Deathwarden nexus (recommended) for carrying necrotic runes, Zemouregal's nexus may be used if owned for a higher-level bone shield at no cost.
or Dive or Bladed Dive
or Mobile perk or Shadow's Grace relic power
Blessing of Het and Expensive spices (recommended) for bolstered healing from food

m.h:
The profit rate assumes 20 kills per hour. Your actual profit may be higher or lower depending on your speed.

Level 80 Mining is recommended, however this boss does not have any strict mining level requirement. Your speed at killing this boss is related only to your mining damage and knowledge of the mechanics.

Kills using a Gargoyle familiar and scrolls will be faster, the cost of the scrolls far outweighs the increase in speed of kills. Instead, this guide assumes that a mining familiar such as a Lava Titan, or a beast of burden is used. With practice, 20 kills per hour is possible. Refer to the strategy page for more information.

m.pg: Money making guide/Collecting Bik Elder Troves

rq.h: or 88 Fishing, 88 Hunter, 88 Mining, or 88 Woodcutting
Recommended: 92 Fishing, 92 Hunter, 92 Mining, or 92 Woodcutting
Fishing: Enhanced fishing rod-o-matic (recommended)
Hunter: Magic butterfly net (recommended)
Mining: Pickaxe of life and death (recommended)
Woodcutting: Hatchet of bloom and blight (recommended)

m.h:
The profit rate assumes 10 T3 troves per hour. Your actual profit may be higher or lower depending on your upgrades.

It's highly recommended to fully upgrade and overcharge the Pontifex shadow ring, it's possible to obtain 10 Elder Trove (Bik, T3) an hour which will give the best money making possible.

To obtain an Elder trove, xp has to be gained within the range of 6:00 to 12:00 minutes whilst being in the Croesus Front; The time delay will depend on the tier of the player's Pontifex shadow ring. It's possible to leave the Croesus front and return to trigger another Elder trove drop, this is useful if you are training another skill that isn't possible within the Croesus front.

High tier augmented tools do not affect your troves per hour and only increase your assumed xp per hour. If you are training a different skill and using the above method to accumulate Troves, the tools on your Tool Belt are adequate.

It's highly recommended to use the Grace of the Elves to gain Seren spirits and make use of porters. Alternatively Magic notepaper can be used to save on porters, but this will be less afk. Use of the porters isn't required if Fishing and you're using the Fury shark outfit's destroy function.

While Fishing, the Fishing rod-o-matic or Enhanced fishing rod-o-matic are required if you wish to use an augmented tool. The Crystal fishing rod does not work on the fishing nodes as they are considered net fishing.

Similar to 0% heat smithing, this method allows the use of the Scripture of Bik to gain clue scrolls. Skilling at the Croesus front has the advantage over smithing by providing Elder trove drops but at the disadvantage of being more click intensive at 1 click per 2 minutes.

m.pg: Money making guide/Collecting Wine of Zamorak

rq.h: 80 Defence
Ranged armour and food recommended

m.h:
Wine of Zamorak is used to create super ranging potions and super Zamorak brews. There is a wine of zamorak spawn that can be taken from the table in the Captured Temple by hand only if the six nearby Monks of Zamorak are dead, or by using Telekinetic Grab, which requires 33 Magic.

The temple is near the Falador lodestone - run north from here to reach it. Use Telekinetic Grab to take the wine. This will make the Monks of Zamorak aggressive, but running east past where Miazrqa wanders will immediately drop their aggro. Alternatively players may kill all the monks and then take the wine by hand. As the wine respawns every 30 seconds, players should hop worlds to obtain more.

The nearby altar permits liberal use of Protect from Magic to prevent the player from taking too much damage from the monks. Once your inventory is full you can bank in Falador and repeat.

If you are able to world hop perfectly after each telekinetic grab you can obtain 120 per hour (a profit of 116400-47280 gp). This can be very difficult to do.

Use of a beast of burden such as spirit terrorbird or pack yak is recommended as it will increase the amount of time collecting wines per hour.

After completing the quest Dragon Slayer, you may return to Duke Horacio on the of Lumbridge Castle at any time to obtain more Anti-dragon shields. The Duke will give you a new shield even if you already have one in your inventory, so the drop trick is not necessary for this method. Speak to the Duke and press the space bar to advance his dialogue, then press the "1" key to select the dialogue option "I seek a shield that will protect me from dragonbreath." Hold the space bar to advance the Duke's dialogue until he gives you a shield, then rinse and repeat. Alternatively, if you unlock your GUI, you can drag the NPC dialogue box so that it overlaps with the Duke. Doing this, you can simply hold down the space bar and click both the Duke and the shield dialogue option without needing to move your mouse.

With high efficiency, you can obtain one shield in about four seconds. You can convert a full inventory of 27 (26 if you already have noted shields in your inventory) Anti-dragon shields into notes at the same time by using a shield on a piece of Magic notepaper. Take care not to left click on the shield, as this will equip it rather than using it. Obtaining at least 800 shields in an hour using Magic notepaper is possible with enough practise. The shields are in high demand so will often instantly sell on the GE.

m.pg: Money making guide/Collecting blue dragon scales
m.h:
Blue dragon scales spawn in the Taverley Dungeon and the Taverley blue dragon resource dungeon, and they are currently worth 1708 coins each. The better place to collect them is the resource dungeon as they're closer together and there are more of them, but that area requires 60 Dungeoneering to access. Without the resource dungeon, you can collect about 550 scales per hour, compared to 900 inside the resource dungeon. 70 Agility is also recommended to avoid having to traverse Taverley Dungeon, which would require a dusty key. A Beast of Burden like the spirit terrorbird, war tortoise, or pack yak are also very helpful to cut down on banking time.

Teleport to Taverley using the Taverley lodestone and head south to the dungeon entrance. Use Surge to travel faster. Enter the obstacle pipe if you have 70 Agility, or otherwise go the long way around (see Map:Taverley Dungeon for details). Enter the resource dungeon if you're able, and start collecting the dragon scales, being careful not to attack any blue dragons by accident. Pick up all of the scales (they respawn very quickly), storing them in your familiar as needed. Enabling area loot will allow you to pick up multiple scales quickly. When your inventory is full, teleport back to Taverley, bank the scales, and repeat. Grinding the scales is usually not worth the time taken and is not recommended, as the scale dust costs much less than the regular scales.

To avoid accidentally attacking blue dragons you can hide the option to attack. Do this by opening Settings > Gameplay Tab > Combat & Action Bar > 'Choose Option' Menu, then under the header NPC attack option use the pull-down menu to choose Hidden. While the attack option is hidden you'll be able to click through blue dragons to get the scales underneath them. This is especially helpful if you need to gather scales outside of the resource dungeon due to lack of access. Be aware this will hide your attack option on all NPC's, so be sure to change this back to the original setting of Combat Level instead of Hidden once you're done gathering the scales.

The rate assume 625 actions are performed per hour, approximately 23 inventories or 2:35 per cycle. It takes a significant amount of time to travel between stations and feed all the Rex babies and then 3 ticks (1.8 seconds) to burn each Potterington Blend #102 Fertiliser. For optimal rates it is suggested you use mobile, double surge, and bladed dive. It is recommended you travel in a circle to each trough and completely feed each Rex baby before moving to the next trough. After feeding each Rex baby once from each trough convert your inventory and repeat the cycle.

One of the possible rotations is starting at the barn:

  1. Beanasaurus Rex (beany mush trough)
  2. Berrisaurus Rex (berry mush trough)
  3. Branasaurus Rex (cerealy mush trough)
  4. Rootlesaurus Rex (rooty mush trough)
  5. Burn fertilizer
  6. Storm barn to pick up more rexes

m.pg: Money making guide/Collecting dinosaur eggs from seggregation
m.h: Dinosaur eggs can be collected quickly from the Seggregation activity by collecting eggs from the pile of dinosaur eggs and destroying the good and bad eggs. This allows the dinosaur eggs which are occasionally found during this activity to be obtained rapidly as there is no need to move between stations in order to produce sharp shell shards. One good/bad egg is obtained per 2 tick allowing for up to 3,000 good/bad eggs per hour each giving a chance at a dinosaur egg. Approximately 4 dinosaur eggs can be obtained per hour in this manner and they can be stored in Beasts of Burden or banked with winter storage scrolls or a legendary pets banking ability.

Grapes spawn on the top floor of the Cooks' Guild. Due to the long respawn time, this method requires world switching to gather grapes more quickly.

Each trip takes 7.5 minutes, or 8 trips per hour. This may vary significantly based on how fast world switching can be done.

While there is also a spawn for grapes in the Phoenix Gang Hideout, it is further from a bank.

Players can also use magic notepaper to note the grapes, eliminating banking time, for an estimated 7221*252 - 529*252 gp per hour; the cost effectiveness would vary depending on the market for both items.

Alternatively, players can kill guards and receive them as a drop, earning around 7221*190 gp per hour, assuming the Killing guards strategy.

If you do not want to switch worlds, you can use another method in conjunction, such as Fletching headless arrows, because Fletching doesn't require banking or a lot of inventory spaces. Profit varies depending on the combinations of methods.

Harmonic dust can be obtained by playing harps within the Ithell district of Prifddinas. Harps are a very low effort way of training crafting, and the harmonic dust has many uses. Once you have acquired all of the crystal items you need, the dust can be made into items and sold for profit - this is a nice supplementary income whilst training crafting. If you're planning on staying at harps for many hours, it's worth buying crystal armour seeds or crystal weapon seeds earlier than you need as they can take awhile to buy on the GE. Approximately 750 dust can be obtained an hour without VoS (or artificer's measure) at level 99 Crafting.

rq.h: Insect repellent

m.h:
Honeycombs are used to make honey badger pouches. They can be extracted from the beehives East of Manor Farm behind the large pen. This requires insect repellent, which can be stored in the toolbelt. Extracting honeycomb is a click-intensive process as you have to right-click and select "Honey" for each one you want, though you can skip the animation of the character collecting the honeycomb by re-clicking the honey option on the same beehive.

Fill your inventory and run to the Manor Farm bank chest and back, and repeat. Use of Surge will decrease the time needed to bank. If the player has access to a Beast of Burden this can be used to further increase the amount of honeycombs that can be gathered per trip.

rq.h: Member

m.h:
Four jangerberries, used to make zamorak brews, can be found on an ogre-infested island north of Gu'Tanoth. The berries respawn about as fast as you can collect them, and since they are currently worth 747 coins, collecting them can be fairly profitable.

Starting at the Castle Wars lobby with only a rope in your inventory and a ring of duelling equipped, run straight east to the island. Use Surge to either cross the bridge or after the point where the character last turns before the lake to speed up the trip. Then, use the rope on the tree branch, jumping over to the island (this will use up the rope).

The ogres on the island are not aggressive. Run in a circle, continually collecting the berries. When your inventory is full, teleport back to the lobby with your duelling ring, bank, and repeat. A bank preset can be used to speed banking up.

There are 4 spawns of limpwurt root in the resource dungeon located within Edgeville Dungeon where the Hill Giants are. To access the dungeon efficiently, a brass key is needed to enter the hut just west of Cooks' Guild. Then, head south to the room containing Hill Giants and limpwurt root spawns.

As they are level 26, Hill Giants are aggressive to any player with a combat level of 52 or less, which may be an annoyance to the gathering process. It is therefore recommended to have at least level 53 combat.

On an averagely populated world, each limpwurt root re-spawns at a rate of around 56 seconds. However, as it takes less than 15 seconds to collect all 4 roots, it is recommended to constantly switch between worlds, effectively eliminating the respawn time. Once the inventory is full, head back up the shortcut to Varrock and bank the limpwurt roots at the Grand Exchange. Use of Surge will allow the player to make faster trips.

rq.h: Uncapped Potential Perk from Player Owned Farms

m.h:
Collecting mort myre fungi is very profitable as it is the secondary ingredient for making super energy potions. While wearing Morytania legs, players will receive double the amount of fungi when collecting. However, make sure there are at least two inventory spaces when collecting, otherwise players will only receive one fungus. Casting bloom affects rotting objects in the 8 squares around the player and consumes between 10 and 60 prayer points (though if the player only has 1 prayer point left, bloom can still be cast). Players should use a location surrounded by 3 rotting logs to increase the chances of obtaining mort myre fungus. An Ivandis flail or blessed silver sickle can be placed on the action bar to cast bloom with hotkeys. Using the action bar, you can increase your profit up to 2,500~ fungus, for an approximation of 6,878,242.5 gp, by being tick-efficient. Players should use the three logs south of the Deposit Box as those are the most efficient. Gathering the fungus by prioritising the logs in the order of South-west, west, then East, you can cast bloom as soon as the mushrooms on the east log disappears, even though your character doesn't appear to be in the center yet. If the fungus on the logs disappears, it indicates that your character has reached that point even if it isn't shown. Using this, you will increase your fungus output by a decent amount. Additionally, you don't need to wait for the bloom effect to end, you can begin harvesting as soon as the stars start to fall and dim.

While harvesting Mort myre fungus, you may rarely receive a Gloomshroom zygomite (unchecked) which sells for 126,837 gp.

Inventory setup should include 3 Prayer renewal (4) or 2 Prayer renewal flask (6), as 10 doses will be consumed in 1 hour. Each renewal dose will recover \textrm{level} \times 4 + 120 prayer points over 6 minutes, though as long as the potion effect is active bloom can be cast indefinitely. Super prayer renewal potion (6) can sometimes be cheaper per dose, having the same duration. As of right now, each Super prayer renewal potion dose is -1,663.25 gp cheaper than a Prayer renewal dose and -1,692.33 gp cheaper than a Prayer renewal flask dose.

If you have completed Deadliest Catch, you will have unlocked a deposit chest along the eastern banks of the River Salve. A short distance south of this, shown in the picture on the right, are 3 rotting logs within a 3 × 3 area. Simply cast bloom, collect, and deposit until you run out of prayer renewal doses. Using the bank deposit chest, this method increases your Mort myre fungi output considerably as it removes the need to bank every inventory; you now only have to bank once after the hour.

You can also increase the amount of fungi through the use of Farm totems on the Player-owned Farm. The Zygomite perk gives a 7% chance to give another mushroom when you gather, at tier one, and a 10% chance at tier two. This stacks with the Morytania legs buff, for a possible three fungi per harvest. Raising Zygomites requires 81 Farming, and the farm totems will only work if Elder Zygomites are in the Medium Pens.

For people that haven't completed Deadliest Catch: first, use the fairy ring network to teleport to . Run west until you see three rotting logs, as shown in the image above. Drink a dose of prayer renewal, stand in the middle of the 3 rotting logs and cast bloom. Mort myre fungi will not spawn every time. Always pick the northern log last because when picked, you will return to the middle, removing the need to click back. After a full inventory, teleport to the TzHaar Fight Cave with the TokKul-Zo to bank and repeat using the fairy ring just north. Alternatively, if you haven't got a TokKul-Zo, use the fairy ring to bank in Zanaris, although this is slightly slower.

Alternatively, players with 68 divination or greater can use sign of the porter IV to bank the fungus. This method will reduce the need for bank trips and increase the yield. Each sign of the porter will transport 20 fungi at a cost of 751.15 gp per charge. Profit per hour will be greater than that of banking at the TzHaar Fight Cave but be less than that of using the deposit chest due to the cost of porters.

Alternatively, players who complete the easy Ardougne achievements (Requires: Biohazard, Gertrude's Cat, Monk's Friend, Plague City, Tower of Life; 15  Fishing, 16  Thieving, 10  Construction), can use the Kandarin monastery Teleport after collecting fungi (but before banking with the TokKul-Zo ) to recharge their prayer point for free. The Kandarin monastery Teleport is a one click teleport spell that isn't interrupted by attacking ghasts unlike the TokKul-Zo. Return with a fairy ring as mentioned above.

m.h:
During or after Enakhra's Lament has been completed you can return to the room where the boneguard was inside Enakhra's Temple and continue to use the take-rock option on the pile of rubble to get sandstone (5kg). You can only have three lots of sandstone in of your inventory at a time so you can either note it with magic notepaper. This guide assumes that sandstone is collected at the fastest rate of actions per hour at 600, with 6 seconds per action.

Alternatively, if you have 20 Crafting, you can grind the sandstone into extra fine sand, which stacks in your inventory. Between 0 and 3 extra fine sand will be produced from the sandstone, with an average of 0.5 sand per sandstone ground. This would give an average of 431 gp per sandstone, for 258,600 gp an hour.

m.pg: Money making guide/Collecting sharp shell shards
m.h:
This guide assumes 1200 eggs converted per hour. Obtained numbers will not be exact but very approximate, as converting eggs gives randomly between 12 to 15 shards each.

Dive/Bladed Dive and Surge are very useful to travel between the pile, compost bin and incubator deposits, which may increase hourly yield, but also increasing intensity.

Using the Shadow-Touched set may also increase XP gained, but in this method, it is possible to use Grace of the elves, as collecting the eggs gives 1 Farming experience, triggering the appearance of the Seren spirit.

Thanks to the quickly ticking Farming exp, this method may also be useful to collect Master farmer fragments.

The usage of a Beast of Burden is also possible, reducing necessary trips to the egg pile, but since the distance between deposits is small, its impact is relatively small.

m.t: Collecting swamp tar from the Lady Zay
m.pg: Money making guide/Collecting swamp tar from the Lady Zay
m.h:
The Lady Zay has many barrels of swamp tar on its decks, which can be looted for substantial profit. Start out by using the Lunar Isle lodestone, and run to the docks and board the Lady Zay. Go down the stairs in the southern end of the ship, and you'll see four barrels of swamp tar. Go to one of them and start clicking on it until it's empty. Do the same for the other three barrels -- the amount of tar varies between 1 and at least 15, but it'll average about three per barrel. Head back to the first barrel you looted, waiting for the tar to spawn again, and start the cycle over again. It takes about 22 seconds for the tar to respawn and is not dependent on the population of the world.

The tar of course stacks, so you'll never have to bank. When you're finished, go to the Grand Exchange and sell the swamp tar, which shouldn't be too difficult as it's a high-volume item.

Swamp toads can be picked up at the swamp northwest of the Grand Tree in the Tree Gnome Stronghold. There are 18 spawns, and it takes approximately 45 seconds for one to respawn on a high-populated world. Because of this, you will have to wait a few seconds after picking up all the toads before you can go through and pick them up again. After you have a full inventory, run east into the Grand Tree and southeast to the central tree with a ladder. There are two banks on the western part of the .

Toad's legs can be made by clicking on the swamp toads in your inventory, yielding 1,095,500 gp per hour. The legs can be quickly pulled off on the run from the swamp to the bank. This usually lowers the value, so be sure to check the prices of both. Currently legs are worth 1,565 gp while the swamp toad itself is 942 gp.

Its highly recommened to only cut the Scruffy zygomites while using crystal knife since it gives a 5% chance to double shafts while fletching and does not degrade when carestyling.

The best Scruffy zygomite to cut is the one closest to the waiting line due to having the shortest animation.

Drying the Scruffy zygomites for experience in Firemaking is not considered as the crystal knife can't be used to boost the output but if you don't have a Crystal knife feel free to do this.

m.h:
White berries spawn in an isolated area in Isafdar, north of the Tirannwn lodestone and just west of some light animica rocks. They respawn very quickly (about 4-5 seconds) after being picked up.

To get to the white berries area, use the Tirannwn lodestone, and click the red dot to the north on the minimap (your character will need to walk northwest then east to get around the trees). Consult the map above if you're unsure how to get there. It should take about 15 seconds to get to the berries from the lodestone. It's possible you'll take damage from the tripwires on the way, but the damage is generally insignificant and you'll be fully healed by the bank.

Once there, just stand over the white berry spawn, clicking it whenever they spawn. After you've collected 28 of them, use the TokKul-Zo to bank, and repeat. Each trip takes about three minutes for a profit of 83,748 gp. Once you've got enough berries, sell them on the Grand Exchange.

It's also possible to use a Beast of Burden to increase the berries per trip. Using a pack yak, you could collect up to 600 berries per hour, for an hourly profit of 1,794,600 gp.

As all you need to do is click once every few seconds, you can do other activities like High Level Alchemy or Disassemble on noted items while you wait.

m.h:
Utilising area loot and movement abilities, white berries may be collected at a faster volume than those found in Isafdar due to two berries spawning on Red Dragon Isle, though this may require more unlocks and attention.

The Wilderness sword 1, which requires the Easy Wilderness achievements, is used to teleport to the Wilderness herb patch. You should utilise Dive and Surge to travel southeast to the agility shortcut on the southern end of Red Dragon Isle. Two hellhounds spawn near the agility shortcut, meaning you can utilise the Barge ability to path towards them if you are lacking in movement ability unlocks or if said abilities are on cooldown. The red dragons on the isle are not aggressive.

It is highly recommended to assign a keybind to the area loot interface through the controls tab in your settings. By doing this, it is possible to spam the keybind in order to remove the slight delay it will take for the white berries to show in the area loot interface once they spawn, allowing for quicker trips.

It is also highly suggested to stand one tile south of the southern white berries spawn, as this will prevent the nearby burnt bones from appearing in your area loot interface and ensure both spawns of berries will.

Once your inventory and familiar are full, teleport to War's Retreat or use the Wilderness sword to teleport to Edgeville. Deposit your berries and return to the Wilderness herb patch once more.

m.pg: Money making guide/Completing Barrows: Rise of the Six

rq.h: or 90 Attack, 90 Ranged, 90 Magic, or 90 Necromancy
Elder overload potion and Super restore flask
High-healing food (Saradomin brews with Sailfish)
Salve amulet, Undead Slayer and Undead Slayer (ability)
A team of 1-3 other players

m.h:
The profit rate assumes 40 chest loots per hour. Your actual profit may be higher or lower depending on your speed.

Barrows: Rise of the Six is the "hard mode" version of the original Barrows. To access their dungeon, a Barrows totem must be acquired; players can either buy from the Grand Exchange, or loot the original Barrows chest. The totems are fairly cheap, costing 4410 coins each; however, each totem lasts for one kill, and is not refunded upon death. Only one player needs to have totems on hand to create an instance.

To defeat the brothers, all six must be simultaneously defeated at once. Each brother has 50,000 life points. Then, upon looting the chest, the player must escape to stabilise the unstable energy; dying or lobbying will cause this energy to disappear. The majority of the profits will come from the energies themselves, although other notable drops include onyx bolts (e), inert adrenaline crystals, huge plated rune salvages and raw rocktails.

With experienced teams, it's possible to loot in excess of 35 chests an hour, as kills can be achieved within 20 seconds or less when prioritising AoE damage with damage boosts and mechanised chinchompas. The best rotation for more kills per hour is Karil on west and Ahrim on east each with any two melee brothers. Players on the east will utilise what people call the door method which will stack Ahrim and the two melee brothers so you can utilise mechanised chinchompas. Players on the west will use mechanised chinchompas whilst sometimes using a melee incite on the Karil side to kill Karil with high burst before he uses a special attack which would prolong kills.

Magic and Melee should only be used by experienced players. Melee should not be used on a side with Ahrim there. Though the kills are incredibly fast compared to other bosses, the most time-consuming part is navigating the tunnels, as it takes 25 seconds on average for a team of four to successfully escape the tunnel, or longer if all four randomised middle segments are bridges with a poor layout. When you need to rebank, inform your team; if possible, try to arrange specific banking times, so everyone returns with full supplies.

If soloing the boss, up to 24-25 chests can be looted in an hour.

Being undead, they are affected by the salve amulet, as well as both the Undead Slayer perk and ability allows players to deal 22% additional damage for 15 seconds, or 7% when the ability is on cooldown.

The formation of the brothers change each day; refer to the table on the right for the formations.

Refer to the strategy page for more information.
